title: CORTEX
technologies: Python, PyQt6, OpenCV, Pydantic, NetworkX, PyAutoGUI, Multithreading, Asynchronous I/O, Tenacity
bullets: Engineered an automated \textbf{workflow execution platform} in \textbf{Python} that orchestrates multi-step data pipelines using a \textbf{directed acyclic graph (DAG)} runtime, \textbf{computer vision}, and \textbf{Pydantic} validation to eliminate repetitive manual processes.

Designed a fault-tolerant \textbf{DAG execution engine} using a token-passing variant of \textbf{Kahn's algorithm} and \textbf{DFS cycle detection}, eliminating convergence deadlocks across conditional branches and enabling non-recursive cyclic loop execution.

Implemented a decoupled \textbf{dispatch registry} with dynamic \textbf{dependency injection} and automated \textbf{exponential backoff retries}, isolating failure domains and ensuring resilient error recovery across 26+ modular execution tasks.

Architected an asynchronous multi-threaded monitoring pipeline utilizing a background \textbf{QThread} and \textbf{PyQt6 signals and slots}, streaming real-time status alerts, execution diagnostics, and logs without blocking critical operations.

title: ALASKA
technologies: Python, Redis, PostgreSQL, PgBouncer, Docker, Node.js, TypeScript, Socket.io
bullets: Architected a \textbf{distributed commute-matching platform} that pairs transit passengers along overlapping routes using \textbf{sub-millisecond path intersection} algorithms and an \textbf{event-driven messaging architecture}.

Automated transit network modeling by developing a \textbf{Python ETL pipeline} to convert multi-sheet timetable datasets into topological graphs, enabling \textbf{Suffix Automaton (SAM)} queries to resolve route overlaps in linear \textbf{O(M) time}.

Engineered an asynchronous message-broker pipeline using \textbf{Redis Streams} and \textbf{PgBouncer}, implementing \textbf{Pending Entries List (PEL) recovery} and chunked batch writes to guarantee \textbf{zero data loss} during worker failovers while shielding \textbf{PostgreSQL} from connection spikes.

Orchestrated a horizontally scalable \textbf{Docker} microservices deployment fronted by \textbf{Nginx} with optimized \textbf{Linux file descriptor limits}, validating system reliability via an automated benchmarking harness sustaining \textbf{14,000+ concurrent connections}.
